rules.rationale: Source: smiles_long lowered solubility (-11.46). LogD opposes logS, so larger carbon scaffolds should raise lipophilicity.
Source: smiles_short raised solubility (+6.89). Small compact molecules expose little nonpolar surface and partition poorly into octanol.
Heteroatom role maps from H-bond donor evidence (weight 0.509); fewer polar atoms means lower desolvation cost, higher partitioning.
Ring role carried the strongest source transfer weight (0.758); fused hydrophobic ring systems favor octanol partitioning.

skills.hypothesis: Transfers ESOL size, heteroatom, and ring effects with reversed sign, treating logD as anti-correlated with logS. Fails if lipophilicity here is size-saturated or governed by polar-group placement rather than bulk hydrophobic surface.

rules.rationale: High heteroatom density increases hydrogen bonding and aqueous stabilization, raising desolvation cost and suppressing measured lipophilicity.
Extended pi surface with only moderate polarity gives large nonpolar contact area; mechanistically meaningful two-condition interaction for octanol partitioning.
Moderate halogen substitution raises polarizability and hydrophobic surface; halogen_mid (743) is far better supported than sparse halogen_high (98).
Counter-hypothesis downweighting the low-confidence (0.224) length transfer: extreme-length molecules often carry polar solubilizing groups, not bulk hydrophobicity.

skills.hypothesis: Domain-knowledge counter-view: polarity penalty plus aromatic and halogen hydrophobic surface drives lipophilicity, and the uncertain length relation reverses at extreme lengths. Fails if bulk molecular size dominates partitioning in this pool.

state.lesson: Development seeds showed the sign-reversed ESOL transfer skill ahead of the halogen-centric domain skill on mean AUC (89.04 vs 85.73) and mean final best (91.42 vs 88.61), with the transfer skill also more stable across seeds. Eight seeds cannot establish mechanism, but they do reverse last generation's deployment choice: the reported source roles, however low their per-field confidence, carried usable signal, while rules anchored on a sparse bin (halogen_high, 98 of 4200) starved the surrogate of coverage.
state.revision_summary: Fixed the schema failure by expressing every conditions object as a direct field-to-value mapping instead of a list of pairs, and gave both skills distinct descriptive IDs. Kept the previously better-performing sign-reversed ESOL transfer skill nearly frozen, only nudging the smiles_long weight up and semantic mass unchanged to avoid overfitting eight seeds. Rebuilt the second skill: replaced the sparse halogen_high rule with well-supported halogen_mid, added a mechanistically motivated aromatic_high x hetero_mid interaction, and retained the very-long-length counterweight that downweights the low-confidence (0.224) length transfer. Deployed the source-evidence-grounded transfer skill.
